correctness.rationale: Read the complete matrix proof. Expanding the kernel gives T_{nk}=m_n(γ) Γ(n−k+s)/(Γ(s)Γ(n−k+1)), k≤n, and Laplace scaling yields m_n≈Γ(s)n^−s(log n)^−γ. Consequently each output row square norm is (1+O(1/log n))/[(2s−1)n(log n)^{2γ}], with locally uniform error near γ=1/2; summation gives Hilbert–Schmidt thresholds and exact divergence coefficients. At γ=0, the matrix is the classical 1/s Cesàro matrix, whose sharp norm is acknowledged prior work; D_γ T_0 gives compactness for γ>0, translated weak-null blocks give noncompactness/unboundedness at γ≤0, logarithmic blocks show essential norm equals norm. Independently recalculated all s=2 γ=0 rows for n<200 with exact fractions and two logarithmically damped integral row asymptotics. No general Schatten-p assertion is made.
